Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer opened and relied on an outdated, user-created IMDb list (“Daniel Craig Movies” with 19 titles, modified years earlier) as if it were a complete filmography. This omitted key recent titles like Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery, so the candidate set never included the correct answer. This early omission led the pipeline to evaluate the wrong pool of movies and culminated in the incorrect final result.
